## Notes

- **Stack profile**: `web-js-ts` (screen_source: route-view). Next.js 16 App Router
  + React 19 + TypeScript + Tailwind 4 + Supabase (`@supabase/ssr`) + next-intl 4.
  Single component, not multi-stack — no `[MULTI_STACK]` flag.
- **This is a REFRESH, not a rebuild** — see `## Changes vs baseline scout` below for the
  full diff against `plans/260905-1447-rebuild-spec-core/artifacts/scout-report.md`.
  App/component/lib source files are identical in count, path, and type tag to the
  baseline; only whitespace/import-order changed inside ~17 of them (Prettier +
  `import/order`), which does not change any File Inventory row.
- **No BL table row for Next.js App Router**: `bl-source-patterns.md` covers Laravel,
  Rails, Django, NestJS, Spring, FastAPI, Go, Rust, .NET, systemd — none is Next.js.
  All BL entries above use `[SIGNAL_INFERRED]`. Only `integration` produced hits;
  every other of the 10 canonical types is genuinely absent from this codebase (no
  cron/queue/observer/mail/notification/custom-command/webhook logic exists at all —
  this is a two-screen auth demo app, not a backend service).
- **`route-view` screen convention applied**: `app/login/page.tsx` and
  `app/todo/page.tsx` are tagged `screen` (each is a distinct route that renders
  primary UI). `app/page.tsx` (`/`) is tagged `route`, not `screen` — its own
  doc comment states it "never itself renders UI," it only redirects based on
  auth state (a fallback to `proxy.ts`'s optimistic redirect). `app/auth/callback/route.ts`
  is likewise a pure redirect-issuing Route Handler with no rendered output → `route`.
- **`screen-embedded` used beyond Delphi TFrame sense**: the template's legend defines
  `screen-embedded` against Delphi `.dfm` TFrame roots, but this is a JS/TS stack with
  no such artifact. Applied here to every visual React component that is NOT itself a
  routed page entry: `app/layout.tsx` (shared chrome wrapping every route),
  `app/login/login-client.tsx` (the `"use client"` boundary owning OAuth-kickoff/locale
  handlers for `/login`), `components/login/login-screen.tsx` (the actual presentational
  root composition Figma calls mm:662:14387, rendered *by* `/login`'s page+client
  boundary, not a route itself), and every other `components/login/**` file (header,
  hero, footer, background, error alert, language selector, and the three SVG icon
  components) — all are sub-regions composed into the `/login` screen, never
  independently routable.
- **Borderline type calls** (flag for Wave 2/7a reviewer):
  - `app/actions/locale.ts` and `app/todo/actions.ts` are Next.js Server Actions
    (`"use server"`) — request-triggered mutations, not a scheduled/queued background
    job. Tagged `other` rather than `background` since the legend's `background`
    definition is "jobs, workers, event listeners, scheduled tasks," none of which
    applies to a synchronous form-bound action.
  - `components/login/login-copy.ts` defines a TS type + default UI-copy object
    (`LoginCopy`), not a domain/business entity. Tagged `other` rather than `model`
    since the legend's `model` is "data model / entity / schema files" (closer to
    domain data than presentational copy defaults).
  - `lib/supabase/next-path.ts` is tagged `permission` (not `other`): it is the sole
    open-redirect guard (`safeNextPath`) gating every `?next=` value before it reaches
    a `Location` header — functionally a security gate, matching the legend's
    "policy, gate, middleware, auth files" even though it has no auth-check code
    itself.
  - `app/fonts.ts` and `app/globals.css` tagged `config` (font/style setup, no
    business logic) rather than `other`.
  - `eslint.config.mjs`, `.prettierignore`, `.github/workflows/ci.yml` (all NEW-to-scope
    this wave) are tagged `config` — toolchain/CI manifests, no business logic. Root

## Changes vs baseline scout (plans/260905-1447-rebuild-spec-core/artifacts/scout-report.md)

1. **`package-lock.json` → `pnpm-lock.yaml`**: confirmed — `package-lock.json` absent,

   confirmed present: `@vitest/coverage-v8`, `@vitest/eslint-plugin`, `eslint-config-prettier`,

   counted twice).
2. **`.github/workflows/ci.yml` CREATED**: confirmed — file exists, two jobs
   (`quality`: lint/format:check/test:unit/build/typecheck; `e2e`: Playwright

   in the baseline scan (root dir listing had no `.github/`).
3. **`.prettierignore` CREATED**: confirmed — 12-line ignore list (node_modules, .next,
